'''Idrosen Gawat''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who after retiring from the [[Mykapo system planetary defense forces|planetary defense force]] of the [[Mykapo system]], came to serve in the [[Resistance]] [[Resistance navy|navy]] as [[captain]] and [[executive officer]] of the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the Resistance and the [[First Order]]. In [[34 ABY]], he was on the bridge of the ''Raddus'' with [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]] and [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] during the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] of the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] and [[Death|died]] when the First Order destroyed the bridge in an [[Battle of Oetchi|attack]] on the fleet after it exited [[hyperspace]] following the [[lightspeed]] jump from D'Qar.

==Biography==
===A veteran's return===
Idrosen Gawat was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who led the [[Mykapo system planetary defense forces|planetary defense forces]] responsible for patrolling the [[Mykapo system]]. After [[Standard decade|decades]] of experience, Gawat retired from the [[Planetary defense forces|defense force]], but returned to action in his seventies when he joined the [[Resistance]] in order to [[Cold War|oppose]] the [[First Order]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> When open [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] broke out against the [[First Order]]<ref name="TLJ" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Gawat was [[captain]] and [[executive officer]] of the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']].<ref name="TLJVD" />

The ''Raddus'' was the largest of four [[Starship|vessels]] used to [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuated]] the Resistance personnel from their [[Resistance base|base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]]. As the Resistance [[transport]]ed its last personnel off the world, the First Order [[First Order Navy|fleet]] arrived and attacked, but after the Resistance's forces successfully destroyed the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|First Order Dreadnought]]<ref name="TLJ" /> ''[[Fulminatrix]]'',<ref name="TLJVD" /> the ''Raddus'' successfully jumped to [[lightspeed]] with the rest of the Resistance forces and escaped.<ref name="TLJ" />

===A sudden end to a long career===
Much to the surprise of the Resistance's commanders, the First Order managed to track them through lightspeed and quickly caught up with them and [[Battle of Oetchi|attacked]] after the ''Raddus'' and other vessels exited [[hyperspace]]. Gawat was [[Death|killed]] along with almost everyone else on board the primary bridge of the ''Raddus'' when two [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]]s successfully struck the bridge with [[missile]]s. Those who were not killed in the initial blast were sucked out into the vacuum of [[Realspace|space]], with only [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] managing to survive the ordeal.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Gawat had tanned skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and white [[hair]].<ref name="TLJ" /> After retiring, he was not quite ready to hang up his rank badge and so joined the Resistance in order to put his decades of experience to good use.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Equipment==
While on the ''Raddus'', Gawat wore a brown, [[brimoss]]-fibre [[Clothing|uniform tunic]] with black [[Resistance officer|Fleet officer's]] uniform trousers, a brown belt and a pair of dark brown service [[boot]]s.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Idrosen Gawat was portrayed by [[Togo Igawa]] in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
